{{Quote|Nix, my second, got himself on the wrong side of an airlock.|Transmission from ''Band Light''|<ref name="FUII">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]''</ref>}}
'''Nix''' was an experienced [[Fringer/Legends|fringer]] who was one of the crew on the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] ''[[Band Light]]'' during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. He and the rest of the crew found a derelict [[Etti Lighter|''Etti''-class light transport]] drifting near the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]<ref name="TFUII" /> at some point before or during [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> Nix, along with the other crew members, went aboard the transport. Nix, however, was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by an Imperial [[Terror Trooper]]. When his body was found in the vacuum of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] outside of an [[Airlock/Legends|airlock]], it was thought by the [[Unidentified captain of the Band Light|captain]] and other crew members that he had died by accident.<ref name="TFUII" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nix was mentioned in the "[[Terror Trooper]]" entry in the in-game databank of the [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 3|PlayStation 3]]/[[Wikipedia:Xbox 360|Xbox 360]] versions of the [[2010]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]''.<ref name="FUII" />
